runs.t: The herd book keeps your breeding records. Craft it from a book and quill and a wheat, with no grid shape needed.

runs.t: Each page is keyed by the animal's herd ID, the first
characters of its genome code. It lists:

items.t: breed or cross, sex and birth day;
calves, and whether a heifer is a freemartin;
the eight trait scores, dressing % and marbling grade.

runs.t: next: both alleles at the coat genes (color, horns, pattern, white and face), what the pair shows, and what it hides. A black cow that reads `ED/e` shows black but carries red: bred to another red carrier, some of her calves come out red. A health page follows.
Use it to pick sires and dams and to spot close relatives before you
, crafted from a book and quill and leather. It holds up to
